tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Areas, neighborhoods and cuisines available for a city and kind of place, with how many ranked places each has. Use to find the exact neighborhood and cuisine names search_places accepts, or to answer what is covered.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places · Public sink: get_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places · Public sink: get_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
